system.description: Choose one Exotic Weapon (Melee) or one of the following Weapon Groups in which you are proficient: Advanced Melee, Lightsabers, or Simple Weapons (Melee). When you make a Melee Attack with a Weapon from the chosen group and the attack roll exceeds the target's Reflex Defense by 5 or more, you deal +1 die of damage with the attack.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Clone Wars Campaign Guide
